q1_issues.issue: The superlative "greatest" is flattened to the plain positive property great, dropping the superlative claim the sentence makes.
That property is attached by Member to the group witness, so it predicates greatness of the group as a single object instead of distributing to the mysteries in it.
"in all of science" loses the "all of" — only the bare domain constant survives in the framing oblique.

q2_gaps: "one of the ADJ-est Ns" — membership in a superlative SET; the instruction set gives Most only for the unique rank-1 superlative and Ordinal only for a stated rank, so a non-unique "one of the greatest" has no licensed form
"all of" + a singular mass / domain noun used emphatically inside a framing PP (not a partitive with a predicate to distribute over, and not a count set to subset)
notes: "of the" plus the cardinal "one" is the partitive trigger, so the letter of the Partitives section asks for a subset group (GroupOf S + SubsetOf + Cardinality 1) rather than the direct PartOf link used here, though PartOf is independently licensed as group membership and reads better for a copular identification. Typing the demonstrative "this" as a mystery off the copular complement is fine.
